Package com.saicone.gama.util

Class LabeledListIterator<L,E>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.gama.util.LabeledListIterator<L,E>
Type Parameters:
L - the type of labels returned by this list iterator
E - the type of elements returned by this list iterator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterator<E>, ListIterator<E>
public class LabeledListIterator<L,E> extends Object implements ListIterator<E>
An implementation of the ListIterator interface compatible with labeled lists.
Unlike a standard ListIterator, this iterator requires a label to be specified when using the set(Object) and add(Object) methods.
